rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: DOM functions that act like 'eval' and execute strings as code are dangerous and impede program analysis and understanding. Consequently, they should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Reinterpreting text from the DOM as HTML can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: A string formatting operation, such as '"%s: %s, %s" % (a,b)', where the number of conversion specifiers in the format string differs from the number of values to be formatted will raise a TypeError.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the called function or method, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Session Fixation
rules.description: Reusing an existing session as a different user could allow an attacker to access someone else's account by using their session.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: An expression that has no effect and is used in a void context is most likely redundant and may indicate a bug.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
rules.description: Calling a method with a user-controlled name may dispatch to an unexpected target, which could cause an exception.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Output Used by a Downstream Component ('Injection')
rules.description: user provided command can lead to execute code on a external server that can be belong to other users or admins

rules.cwe_name: Use of Less Trusted Source
rules.description: A remote endpoint identifier is read from an HTTP header. Attackers can modify the value of the identifier to forge the client ip.
